hypotheses.mechanism: Compiler/gate evidence should require a provenance-linked source_hash -> parser/grammar -> AST_hash -> typed_IR_hash -> semantic_hash -> lowering_version -> artifact_hash -> execution_receipt chain.
hypotheses.expected: A deliberately skipped or manually synthesized stage is detectable and cannot be mislabeled end-to-end compiler conformance.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Separate parser and lowering receipts are sufficient even without a joined ancestry chain.
hypotheses.falsifier: A production compiler audit can reconstruct the same unambiguous ancestry and semantic-preservation proof without explicit joined chain identity.
hypotheses.implication: Refine CC-WP-02/03/06/11 and APP acceptance receipts; no new core syntax required.

hypotheses.mechanism: ClayCode needs explicit typed control-result/termination semantics; generic emit/event semantics should not be silently lowered as return.
hypotheses.expected: Production parser/IR represents whether a branch emits, yields, returns, or continues, and differential lowering preserves it.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Current ClayCode already normatively defines emit as terminating in a source not loaded by this run.
hypotheses.falsifier: A current admitted semantic contract is found that explicitly defines emit as the same terminating operation implemented by the prior Python lowerer.
hypotheses.implication: Do not promote return/yield syntax yet; first locate existing universal-core semantics or use an APP/FRANK counterexample.

hypotheses.mechanism: The prior fixture's cycle name is research-harness metadata unless a real executable program requires callable/exported named cycles.
hypotheses.expected: Removing the unreferenced label can make the fixture conform to current cycle header without changing its intended research behavior.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Named cycles are already a required callable language entity.
hypotheses.falsifier: A current admitted program or acceptance exemplar references/exports a cycle by name and cannot be expressed via existing generic declarations.
hypotheses.implication: Fix the fixture first; do not add named-cycle syntax solely to rescue a test.
